desc: Action-command assists at Wider windows (attacks and guards 1, as the Accessible preset sets them; never Automatic), no guard pressed: the boss rush's Paper Mario 64 Lava Piranha (step 22) with the auto battler pressing nothing (TTYD_AUTO_BATTLE_ASSIST=1: the assists at 1, no presses). Every hit on Mario must be judged unguarded (result 2), never a Guard (4) or Superguard (5): wider windows still need a press
